聚焦42维树集成

7页主讲、8页附录。主线：时间基线、conflicts基线、逐题差异、聚类、42维输入、成本分类集成、2.35%费后开发结果。旧回归、解释与小规则尝试移至附录，不与当前分类器混报。

R54完整summary从连接的实验对话中未截断的命令输出取得：mean3改善2.3499866537517358%，3423解，D3385，救66丢28。实际输入/查询费用已组合；模型选择已看过开发成绩，不是独立确认，也不是新同机端到端部署。原42维输入由本地冻结源码独立核对。未启动新求解或拟合。

当前最好是成本加权分类树集成，输出相对D的偏好分数，非预计节省秒数。R12旧回归器才预测D−F成本；其2.10% query-only口径已从主讲撤下。

1. Baseline by CPU time

必要性：保持教授要求的基线与逐题证据

中文逻辑与英文讲稿
中文讲述逻辑
先定义三种配置：D为原生默认，F+偏真，F−偏假。横轴是每题CPU时间预算，纵轴是该预算内已验证解出的题数。曲线来自完整4719题矩阵，截止600秒。D解3385题，逐题选最优的VBS解3547题，净多162题。10.85%来自总PAR2降低，并不是曲线面积或解题数百分比。

English speaker script
We now have the full three-configuration baseline on the retained Anniversary 2022 collection. D uses native phasing. F-plus and F-minus prefer true and false. At 600 CPU seconds, default solves 3,385 instances. If we could choose the best configuration separately for every instance at no cost, we would solve 3,547. That is 162 additional solves and a 10.85 percent reduction in penalized runtime. This is the opportunity our selector tries to capture.

Sources
raw_data_20261110/statistics.json; vbs_preferences_20261110/all_preferences.csv
Filtering: 5,355 original entries minus 636 unsolved by all official tracks = 4,719. 14,157 configuration runs. CPU-time VBS minimizes time, not conflicts.

中文讲述逻辑
这张图仍用同一批T600运行，只换横轴。横轴采用log(1+conflicts)间距，所以0冲突也保留。VBS对conflicts单独逐题最小化，可能与时间VBS选择不同配置。不要把这张图说成重新运行的统一冲突预算实验，也不要把conflicts称为无条件硬件无关。8条超时轨迹缺失conflicts；已解出轨迹完整。

English speaker script
The second view uses conflicts instead of CPU seconds. It counts verified solutions as the conflict threshold increases, using only completions observed in our existing 600-second runs. We compute the virtual best separately for conflicts. It can therefore choose a different configuration from the time-based virtual best. This gives us a second view of search work, without claiming a new experiment under a conflict limit.

3. Phase effects vary sharply by instance

中文逻辑与英文讲稿
中文讲述逻辑
教授要求看散点图两侧的具体实例。横轴D，纵轴F，均是CPU秒对数间距；下方F快，上方D快。已完成对显示为点，只有一方完成为三角；未完成放专用TO边界，不伪装成600秒精确解题时间。双方超时不画数值点，保留在neither计数。F+独有92题，D独有401题；F−独有112题，D独有442题。1–4为实测极端例子，不是平均加速，也不是新规则的验证。接下来问这些差异能否从结构预知。

English speaker script
Cumulative curves hide large differences between individual formulas. Each point compares the same formula under D and one forced phase. Below the diagonal favors the forced phase; above favors D. F-plus solves ninety-two instances that D misses, while D solves four hundred and one that F-plus misses. For F-minus, those counts are one hundred and twelve and four hundred and forty-two. Examples one to four show large gains and losses. They are descriptive extremes, not average speedups. We now ask whether structure can predict when switching helps.

Sources
vbs_preferences_20261110/all_preferences.csv; meeting 7:21–8:20 and 12:04–13:40
Example 1: instance_key=0cbe117e0149223a332679d6c206273e; F+ versus D. D: 161.984443 CPU s, 5,698,055 conflicts. F+: 0.282904 CPU s, 18,432 conflicts. Both solved. D/forced CPU ratio=572.577422.
Example 2: instance_key=5baf53a177ccc89279e37e5d52b3c973; F+ versus D. D: 0.124855 CPU s, 6,144 conflicts. F+: 362.428621 CPU s, 16,197,696 conflicts. Both solved. D/forced CPU ratio=0.000344.
Example 3: instance_key=7efdf72de31fa82aeceb7acbc29a59bf; F− versus D. D: 539.664543 CPU s, 9,423,719 conflicts. F−: 0.601349 CPU s, 2,907 conflicts. Both solved. D/forced CPU ratio=897.423199.
Example 4: instance_key=69ceafaa83839dbe53dc801c483e9991; F− versus D. D: 0.029337000000000002 CPU s, 229 conflicts. F−: 115.93625 CPU s, 4,338,397 conflicts. Both solved. D/forced CPU ratio=0.000253.
Selection: Within pairs solved by both: maximize D/F time ratio with D time >5 s for wins; maximize F/D ratio with F time >5 s for losses. Descriptive extremes, not average gains or held-out discoveries.

4. Clustering by formula structure

必要性：保持教授要求的基线与逐题证据

信息负荷与位置：图、坐标、计数与实例证据保留，不因聚焦分类器而删除。

中文逻辑与英文讲稿
中文讲述逻辑
用同一个教学公式说明特征：(x∨y)∧(¬x∨y∨z)，两子句长度为2和3，所以均长2.5；一个是二元，一个全正，两个比例都是50%。这三项均在原8簇的12项特征中，显示原尺度；日志变换、裁剪和标准化见附录。右侧“D最好”指簇内平均PAR2最低，不是每个成员都偏好D。原8簇人口为61、502、441、843、572、165、1504、631。Astra建议属于更广的结构探索，不能与该12项输入混为一谈。扩展15组的0.1573%区间为−0.3062%到0.6343%。

English speaker script
Here are concrete examples of what we clustered. The two clauses have lengths two and three, so the average length is two point five. One of the two clauses is binary, and one is all-positive, giving fifty percent for each feature. The actual clustering uses twelve static features. In each of the original eight clusters, D has the lowest mean penalized runtime. A broader clustering search gave only a small uncertain gain. The full feature list and preprocessing are in the appendix.

5. 42 statistics describe each formula

必要性：给42个输入一个可讲述的定义

信息负荷与位置：按5类列出2+11+4+10+15，既可加总又不把42个机器列名挤进主讲。先类别，再测量对象，最后维度；Horn就地定义，完整列名与变换移附录。

中文逻辑与英文讲稿
中文讲述逻辑
本页回答42维到底是什么，不把它们说成42条单独选相位的规则。2个规模：变量范围、子句数；11个长度比例：空、1到9、≥10；4个符号类型比例：全正、全负、Horn、dual-Horn；10个符号均衡统计：逐子句和逐变量两种分布各5项；15个活动统计：变量出现次数、Horn参与、dual-Horn参与三种分布各5项。合计2+11+4+10+15=42。均衡度是min(正,负)/max(正,负)，0表示单边，1表示相等。分布的五个量为均值、方差、最小、最大以及固定提取器记录的entropy；部分输入有对数或尺度归一化。精确42列和边界语义见附录。这里不加入63个联合分布或可用标志。

English speaker script
The model uses exactly forty-two statistics from the formula. They are measurements, not forty-two independent decision rules. No application-family names, instance identifiers, satisfiability answers or solver runtime labels are available as prediction inputs. The groups are size, clause lengths, clause signs, sign balance, and variable activity. The counts are two, eleven, four, ten, and fifteen. Sign balance has five summaries across clauses and five across variables. Variable activity has five summaries each for total occurrences, Horn participation and dual-Horn participation. All forty-two numbers go into the ensemble together; no one feature is claimed to determine the winning phase.

6. Use cost-weighted trees to select a phase

必要性：讲清当前最好的分类集成，而非沿用旧回归叙述

信息负荷与位置：左到右为42维输入、F对D偏好分数、阈值切换。训练费用差异用一行解释；三模型平均只写一次，不把分数伪称秒数或校准胜率。

上一版对应页
中文逻辑与英文讲稿
中文讲述逻辑
当前最好是42维成本加权分类树集成，不是R12回归器。每个训练动作权重为(max各动作PAR2−该动作PAR2)/1200。每个ExtraTrees分类模型给三个动作分数，F分数减D分数得到两个偏好分数；平均三个训练seed模型的差分分数。若最大的F偏好超过内层验证阈值，选择它，否则D。这些分数不是预计节省的秒数，也不是校准过的赢家概率。每模型256树、深度≤12；三模型mean3。

English speaker script
The current candidate uses cost-weighted ExtraTrees classifiers. Training gives more weight to actions that avoid high PAR2 costs. Each model produces a preference score for F-plus and F-minus relative to D. We average the scores from three trained models. If the stronger forced-phase score exceeds a threshold chosen on inner validation, we use that phase; otherwise we use D. These are preference scores, not a prediction of seconds saved or calibrated winning probabilities.

必要性：用相同PAR2分母展示当前2.35%与10.85%免费上限

信息负荷与位置：保留两条横条、净多38解、实测费用已含以及开发回放限定。完整费后R54替换旧query-only 2.10%，未改写历史模型成绩。

中文讲述逻辑
R54主mean3成本分类器完整费后相对D改善2.3499866537517358%，平均PAR2从392.54265364738285降至383.31795367638654。解出3423，比D3385多38；救66、丢28。既有特征提取逻辑费用2027.491558886秒、查询83.279956秒，25次采集失败按已支付开销后D回退。费用跨主机组合回放，不是同机端到端solver部署。混合5折911/962/927/1009/910，等价实例组不跨训练评价；本系列反复开发，mean3依据已曝光的2.4%历史选中，非盲选。名义等价组95%区间[1.3988798%,3.2886044%]未校正模型选择。免费VBS10.85%仍取同4719题、相同600秒预算；它没有采集或选择费用。

English speaker script
On the same 4,719 formulas, the cost-weighted forty-two-feature ensemble reduces PAR2 by 2.35 percent relative to always using D, including the measured feature extraction and prediction costs. It solves 3,423 instances, thirty-eight more than D. Free perfect selection offers a 10.85 percent ceiling. This is a mixed five-fold development replay using previously recorded runtimes and costs. The model was selected after earlier development results, so we still need independent confirmation and actual end-to-end deployment.

This supports a conditional prediction signal within represented regions, while transfer to new structures remains unresolved.

必要性：保留此前解释回归模型的尝试

中文逻辑与英文讲稿
中文讲述逻辑
使用附件名称Astra。我们不把未指明的LLM权重论文写成支持本实验的证据，只说明借鉴读权重的想法并直接检查保存树。Astra完成7条规则解释，不能宣称完整忠实压缩。R26选特征1(log clause count)和16(dual-Horn fraction)，阈值在各训练折内重拟合；加第三个条件为balance-clause entropy。图中仅展示模板，不捏造全局统一阈值。

English speaker script
To obtain a small rule that we could apply and inspect directly, we asked Astra to inspect the saved ensemble. It returned seven candidate rules. One concrete template combines the number of clauses with the fraction of dual-Horn clauses, then selects F-plus inside that region and D otherwise. We refit the thresholds within each training fold. Reading a model can suggest hypotheses, but a readable rule still has to retain the original cost advantage when evaluated.

中文逻辑与英文讲稿
中文讲述逻辑
四行不能写成相同费用条件：原森林含query费，简化模型是免费feature/query筛选。即使给简化模型免费条件，R26仅0.1717%，R31仅0.4931%，R32仅0.4401%，都没有保住2%。这些是模型压缩/可解释化结果，而不是所有简单规则不可能的证明。当前下一步优先补齐原候选采集费、冻结候选并选择新的独立测试人口。

English speaker script
The compact candidates have not retained the ensemble gain. The two-condition template gives about 0.17 percent, the readable tree about 0.49 percent, and the directional small rules about 0.44 percent. Those compact screens even assume free features and queries, so they do not reproduce the original two-percent result. Our current conclusion is that there is a predictive signal, but we do not yet have a simple rule that preserves it or a demonstrated transfer result.

中文讲述逻辑
原八簇共有12维：log1p变量数、log1p子句/变量数、log1p平均长度；单位、二元、三元、长度≥5子句比例；全正、全负以及dual-Horn减Horn子句比例；log1p变量度CV；log1p连通分量/变量数。四类特征按1/sqrt(类内维数)加权。clipping、均值和标准差在训练折拟合，再用于评价折。正二元比例另有相关分析，但不是原8簇的12个输入之一；不把它或所有Astra建议都混进本实验。

English speaker script
These are the twelve actual inputs to the original clustering. They cover size, clause lengths, clause signs and connectivity. We show their natural meanings here. The implementation applies the specified logarithmic transforms and fits clipping and standardization within training folds. Group weights prevent a category with more dimensions from dominating simply because it has more features.

教授要求保存并比较同一题各配置的conflicts。这页用已完成轨迹逐题配对，不靠累计图的边际分布推断。0用log(1+count)保留；只显示双方均在600 CPU秒完成的2984及2943对。超时的冲突计数不是解题总工作量，因此不混入。1–4与时间页四题一致，四例方向一致；不据此推出整个样本的因果解释。单侧解出题仍在时间页与源数据保留。

English speaker script
Here is the requested paired view of conflicts. We compare the same formulas, keeping pairs where both configurations completed within the existing six-hundred-second runs. Lower points mean fewer conflicts under the forced phase. Examples one through four are the same as in the time plot. Their advantages and disadvantages also appear in conflicts, without establishing a causal mechanism for the whole population. Zero-conflict completions remain through log-one-plus-count spacing.

15. Appendix: exact 42-input mapping

必要性：给完整42维复现和扩展边界留一个位置

信息负荷与位置：8组坐标范围与语义对齐；五个分布摘要和规范化说明在此定义。63联合分布仅说明不属于当前42维，不占主讲或混入2.35%证据。

中文逻辑与英文讲稿
中文讲述逻辑
逐坐标映射见下列完整清单。entropy是固定GBD实现记录的分布摘要，不另换实现。规模中的变量数遵循固定提取器的DIMACS变量编号范围，可含未使用编号；变量均衡保留上游v<n_vars边界，未静默修复后再混用旧模型。长度空比例为max(0,1−其他长度比例之和)。全正/全负及Horn比例按固定原始提取器定义处理空子句。三个活动分布的5变换为log1p(mean)、log1p(variance/max(mean²,1e−12))、min/max(mean,1e−12)、log1p(max/max(mean,1e−12))及entropy。这些复现细节不在主讲展开。63个长度×正文字比例分箱只放在这里说明边界，不作为当前最好模型的一部分。

English speaker script
This is the complete coordinate map. The five summaries are mean, variance, minimum, maximum, and the extractor’s entropy statistic. The occurrence groups apply the frozen logarithmic and mean-normalized transforms. The exact source semantics are retained, including boundary behavior. The extra sixty-three length-by-sign bins belong to a separate experimental input and are not part of the current forty-two-feature ensemble.
